set.body:
Objective
Make the tested module set, published artifact set, documentation, consumer evidence, and tag workflow one coherent release contract.

Acceptance criteria
- A checked-in authoritative release command is invoked by protected-branch CI and tag publication.
- Every published JVM and Scala.js artifact receives equivalent test, optimized-link, POM, binary, source, documentation, and compatibility inspection.
- Nonpublished experimental modules cannot inherit the core 1.0 version accidentally.
- Fresh JVM and Scala.js consumers resolve only locally published candidate artifacts.
- Gale plus one additional substantial consumer pass without internal Ravel access.
- The supported JDK, Node, browser, Scala, and architecture evidence matrix is documented.
- Milestone and RC tags prohibit feature additions after RC1.
- All child tickets are closed from one candidate commit.
set.title: EPIC: Make core 1.0 publication single-source and reproducible
